correctness.rationale: The direct good-Broyden rank-one update yields the exact second-iterate identity. The Rayleigh quotient lies in [mu,L], every Stieltjes off-diagonal contributes nonnegatively, and a_ii<=L gives positivity whenever gamma>=L-mu. The two-dimensional diagonal family makes the high-curvature coordinate negative for every smaller gamma. Exact rational replay confirms the algebra and explicit witness.

value.rationale: The scalar initial Jacobian B0=gamma I is a natural low-information quasi-Newton initialization, and Stieltjes systems have a genuine nonnegativity interpretation through inverse positivity. The exact safety threshold gamma=L-mu, minimal-dimensional failure, and condition-number-two specialization give a usable initialization rule and regression test rather than a routine convergence calculation.
